title: Training Your Own Embedding Model Is Not As Hard As You Think

unknowns.whyItMatters: Pi can report input, output, cache, reasoning tokens, and a catalog price on each response. This conversion ran before that was saved. Character counts of the files are not tokens, so no dollar figure is estimated.
English auto-captions existed, but YouTube returned HTTP 429 after repeated fetches. The transcript is local faster-whisper (small, CPU). Its mistakes against the soundtrack were not measured.
The video is 12m 36s and the episode is 5m 18s, about 42 percent of the runtime. The sentence check only rejects a script that recites the HTML. It does not say which claims were dropped.

Wall clock is 1h 22m 33s from the launcher log, 15:26:48Z to 16:49:22Z. About 54 minutes of that was a Kokoro segment that stopped advancing and was resumed. The split is reconstructed from log times, not from a stage timer.
An earlier attempt was killed during transcription, before any model call. It should not have added model tokens. That was not confirmed from a provider bill.
Kokoro weights were downloaded on this machine during testing. That download is not assigned to this episode.
The source is the Prompt Engineering channel. The ledger does not decide whether this episode may be published.
Local transcription, a 145 MB wav, 19 voice parts, and the final m4a used this laptop. None of that is on the model bill.

notes: Reconstructed on 2026-10-08 from the finished files and the run log. This row is not a second conversion.

title: Anthropic Engineers Just 10x'd Everyone's Claude Code

unknowns.whyItMatters: This run was driven from a Claude Code session. The session does not expose per-response token counts or a catalog price to the model, so none is recorded and none is estimated from characters.
The transcript is YouTube auto-captions (en-orig). They misspell names (Enthropic, Thoric, Boris Jurnney). Errors against the soundtrack were not measured; names were corrected from context.
The episode is 351.9 s of a 742 s video (47.4%). The overlap check only rejects recitation of the HTML. It does not say which claims were dropped.

Figures (80%, 13.9% to 85%, 49% to 74%, 79.5% to 88.1%, 563 tokens, 252 startups, 223 transcripts) are the presenter's statements. They were not checked against the Anthropic article or the 2025 paper.

notes: First fetch failed: ffmpeg was not on PATH (yt-dlp subtitle conversion needs it). The script then downloaded a 142 MB wav (36 s) that was not needed. Both were removed. ffmpeg came from WinGet Links, added to PATH for the shell only.
scripts/fetch_source.py chose caption track 'en' and got no vtt. Track 'en-orig' downloaded in 3 s by hand. Cause not diagnosed.
Script pass 1 had 2 recited sentences; pass 2 had 0.
Loudness of episode.m4a measured at -16.3 LUFS integrated. 8 chapter marks. Kokoro ran at 168 s for 351.9 s of audio (0.48 x real time) on this machine. No segment stalled.
